AFL: Sydney Swans v Brisbane Lions at the Sydney Cricket Ground in Moore Park. Gates open at 2.15pm. First bounce at 4.15pm, full-time approx 6:55pm.

With up to 40,000 fans expected, traffic will be heavy on roads approaching Moore Park. Motorists should expect delays and allow extra travel time on the Eastern Distributor, Moore Park Rd, Cleveland St, Anzac Pde, Oxford St and Lang Rd.

Changed traffic conditions:

  • Driver Ave will be partially closed outside the stadium from 1.15pm and will reopen after crowds have cleared the area.
  • No through-traffic will be available on Driver Avenue, however access to EP2 Kippax car park will be maintained via Moore Park Rd and access to EP3 grass car park and drop-off areas maintained from Lang Rd. Grass car parks open from 1.15pm.
  • Special event clearways will be in place on roads in Moore Park and surrounding areas from 1pm to 9pm on sections of Albion Street, Fitzroy Street and Lang Road, from 3pm to 9pm on a section of Moore Park Road, and from 6am to 9pm on Cleveland Street.  

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types and apply even to local residents and TfNSW Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.

Misneach Irish Music Festival at the Phillip Precinct in The Domain on Sunday from 12pm to 11pm.

Traffic will be heavier than usual in the Sydney CBD on approaches to The Domain before and after the event. Motorists should allow plenty of extra travel time and watch out for pedestrians in the area.

Road closures will be in place between 7pm and midnight for crowd safety before, during and after the event.

A dedicated drop off zone will be located on Hospital Rd at Art Gallery Rd.

From 7pm to midnight

  • Art Gallery Rd will be closed at Hospital Rd

From 9.45pm to midnight (at the direction of NSW Police)

  • College St from Park St to Prince Albert Rd  
  • Hospital Rd from Art Gallery Rd to Shakespeare Place  
  • Hunter St from Elizabeth St to Macquarie St  
  • Macquarie St from Bent St to Prince Albert Rd
  • Prince Albert Rd from Macquarie St to Art Gallery Rd  
  • St Mary’s Rd from Prince Albert Rd to Cathedral St   
  • St James Rd from Elizabeth St to Macquarie St  

Motorists should follow directions of signage and traffic controllers on site.

properties.otherAdvice:
Cyclists will take part in the Grafton to Inverell Cycle Classic on Saturday 15 March, starting from Prince Street in Grafton and finishing on Vivian Street, Inverell. The race will commence at 7:15am with rolling road closures in place from 6.30am and the last riders are expected to reach Inverell by 5pm.

The Gwydir Highway between Tindal Road (15km west of Grafton) and Bald Nob Road (25km east of Glen Innes) will be closed westbound from 7:00am to 1:30pm and eastbound between 5am and 1.30pm.

  • Grafton closures: Prince Street between Victoria Street to the river 5.30am to 8.30am. Bent Street-Charles Street roundabout and Ryan Street-Skinner Street roundabout from 7am-7.45am.
  • The event will be travelling on the Gwydir Highway between Glen Innes and Dodds Lane (20km east of Inverell) between 9.30am and 4pm.
  • Elsmore Road at Inverell will be under traffic control for the event and motorists travelling in the area should allow extra travel time. Local traffic will have limited access to Elsmore Road during this period.
  • Motorists are advised to exercise caution, allow extra travel time and follow the directions of traffic control on site.
properties.diversions: Please plan your journey and consider using one of the alternate east-west corridors such as Oxley Highway, Bruxner Highway or Waterfall Way between closure times.
